definitions.explanation: A spiral-shaped incense that repels mosquitoes when burned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Mosquito coils are essential in summer.

examples.japanese: {蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焚|た}いて→焚く：02285_taku⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I burn a mosquito coil and go to sleep.

examples.japanese: {蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風物詩|ふうぶつし}→風物詩：08649_fuubutsushi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The smell of mosquito coils is a sign of summer.

notes:
FORMATION:
⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧ (mosquito) + ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (repelling) + ⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧ (incense)

USAGE:
・{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焚|た}く→焚く：02285_taku⟧ (to burn a mosquito coil)
・{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to light a mosquito coil)
・{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (mosquito coil holder - pig-shaped ones are iconic)

CULTURE:
{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう} is closely associated with Japanese summer. The distinctive green spiral coil and its smoke are nostalgic symbols. Traditional holders are often shaped like pigs (⟦{蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}→蚊遣り豚：30353_kayaributa⟧).

MODERN ALTERNATIVES:
・⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦{蚊取|かと}り→蚊取り：23175_katori⟧ (electric mosquito repellent)
・⟦{蚊取|かと}り→蚊取り：23175_katori⟧⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧ (mosquito mat)
・⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧⟦{蚊取|かと}り→蚊取り：23175_katori⟧ (liquid mosquito repellent)
